question: im on a vpn and my ip keeps changing so blocking my IP in settings doesnt really work. how do i stop counting my own visits?

citations.quote: You can then set a special `localStorage` flag in your browser so you don't need to frequently block new IP addresses.

Open the **Console** tab in your browser's developer tools on your site, then paste this command and hit enter:

localStorage.plausible_ignore=true

evidence.title: Let visitors opt out of being counted
evidence.text:
To keep your own visits or your team's out of your stats, block your IP addresses in your site settings. That works across all your browsers and devices at once.

If your IP address changes often or you use a VPN, you can set the same flag yourself instead. Open the **Console** tab in your browser's developer tools on your site, then paste this command and hit enter:

```html
localStorage.plausible_ignore=true
```

Do this for every domain, subdomain and browser you want to exclude. To be counted again, run:

```html
delete localStorage.plausible_ignore
```

You can also use the opt-out page above instead of the console.

question: I'm on the free trial and want to start paying. Where do I click, and what can I pay with?
reference_answer: Click the trial days left button in the top right, then Upgrade in the Subscription section, choose your tier and plan and continue to pay through Paddle. You can pay by credit or debit card, PayPal, Apple Pay or Google Pay.
key_facts: Click the trial days left button then Upgrade
Card, PayPal, Apple Pay or Google Pay
answer:
1. In the top right, click the **X trial days left** button, then click **Upgrade** in the **Subscription** section [1].
2. Click **Pay securely via Paddle**, choose your location, then pick a payment method [1].

evidence.title: Upgrade from trial to a paid subscription
evidence.text:
Log in to your Plausible account. In the top right, click the **X trial days left** button, then click **Upgrade** in the **Subscription** section.

Subscribe before your dashboards and stats are deleted to keep your historical stats. Nothing is reset when you upgrade. See what happens when your trial ends.

Upgrade your trial account to a paid subscription

## Choose your tier and plan

Our subscription tiers are based on total pageviews and custom events across all the sites in your team. Check your current usage in the **Subscription** section and pick a tier that matches. You can get 2 free months with an annual subscription.

Next, choose a plan:

- **Starter** - Essential features for solo projects and new sites
- **Growth** - Team access and sharing tools for growing projects
- **Business** - Advanced marketing features, more sites and larger teams
- **Enterprise** - Custom plan with tailored limits. Contact us to discuss or learn more

Compare plans and pricing on our website. Then click **Upgrade** to continue.

Choose your subscription tier

Not sure which tier or plan to pick? See Choose the right subscription for details on how usage is calculated, what happens with traffic spikes and how to manage your plan over time.

## Pay and subscribe

Billing is handled by Paddle, our payment processor. Click **Pay securely via Paddle**, choose your location, then pick a payment method. You can pay by credit/debit card, PayPal, Apple Pay or Google Pay.

Choose your location

Fill in your details and click **Subscribe Now**.

Subscribe now

evidence.title: Billing FAQ
evidence.text:
Credit/debit card, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay. All payment processing is handled by Paddle. Larger annual plans can also be paid by invoice and bank transfer on request. We're not able to accept cryptocurrency.

Paddle automatically emails you an invoice after every payment. Our purchasing and vendor information page covers company details and purchasing documents.

If paying via PayPal, make sure a valid card is linked to your PayPal account. Paddle requires this for recurring subscriptions.
